Maya R: Quick postmortem follow-up: consolidating remediation owners and timelines so game-day prep isn't blocked.
Tomas B: Send the list and I'll take routing-related items.
Maya R: Items: 1) Routing failover dry-run + comms play (owner: Tomas, due 2026-04-10) 2) Restore runbook update with approval gate + rollback commands (owner: Hana, due 2026-04-07) 3) Backup snapshot audit + restore time samples (owner: Hana, due 2026-04-07) 4) Cache-priming step + traffic replay (owner: Tomas, due 2026-04-10) 5) Schedule monthly restore rehearsal in non-prod (owner: Platform Eng, recurring).
Hana S: I'll own the runbook and snapshot audit. Plan: CSV of snapshots, retention mismatches, restore time estimates. Flag any restore >45m.
Tomas B: For routing dry-run, prefer manual warm-standby promotion for first two rehearsals. I'll draft the cutover steps and a comms checklist.
Maya R: ops-bot, can you create a JIRA epic and schedule a rehearsal window?
ops-bot: Created epic RI-3010 "DR remediations - postmortem" and scheduled "DR rehearsal - routing & restores" for 2026-03-30 23:00 UTC. Tickets: RI-3011..RI-3014.
Hana S: Noted recurring pattern: KV cache cold starts after failover. I'll include a cache validation step after restores.
Tomas B: Adding a pre-seed traffic replay script under /infra/dr/replay; will attach to ticket.
Maya R: Closure checklist: schedule dry-run, update runbook with gate and rollback, complete snapshot audit, add SLI for restore time <=45m, and confirm monthly rehearsals. Reconvene 2026-04-11 for signoff.
Hana S: ACK, will post CSV and runbook draft by due date.
Tomas B: ACK.
Maya R: Thanks team. :thumbsup:
